news.analysis: Fantasy managers in PPR formats were certainly okay with McMillan's performance in this one. The volume was there, but the Packers did a great job of limiting the second-year star's yardage. McMillan has now caught 30 passes over his last four games and is averaging exactly six per contest for the season. However, he scored both of his touchdowns in Week 4 against the Lions. He remains a high-end WR2 in most formats.

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan hauled in six of 11 targets for 58 yards in the 27-19 loss to the Green Bay Packers. While McMillan secured enough short passes to salvage his stat line, he was unproductive downfield and in the red zone in Week 8. Since his monster game in Week 4, McMillan has caught 16 passes for 184 yards and no touchdowns, averaging under nine half-PPR fantasy points per game. news.analysis: Williams hauled in four and three passes, respectively, over the previous two games heading into Thursday night. He is a factor for the Packers' offense, but he's well behind fellow wide receivers Matthew Golden and Christian Watson, as well as TE Tucker Kraft, in the pecking order for targets from QB Jordan Love. Workhorse RB Josh Jacobs is back in the fold as well. Williams has playmaking potential, but the volume just isn't there right now for fantasy purposes.

news.contents: The Chicago Bears have acquired star defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons from the Tennessee Titans in exchange for two first-round picks and a fourth-round pick, according to Tom Pelissero of The Ringer. Simmons is a superstar on defense, earning four Pro Bowl honors throughout his career. He was also named a First Team All-Pro last season after amassing 11 sacks, 67 tackles, 17 tackles for loss, and 21 quarterback hits.
